## Why This Is Asked

This question tests practical Android experience with on-device config, offline resilience, and security.

## Key Concepts

- Room data modeling for versioned configs and audit logs
- Offline-first evaluation with per-user targeting

```kotlin
data class ConfigEntity(

)
```

```kotlin
data class Delta(val id: String, val changes: Map<String, Any>, val clock: Long)
fun merge(d1: Delta, d2: Delta): Delta {
  val clock = maxOf(d1.clock, d2.clock)
  val mergedChanges = d1.changes + d2.changes
  return Delta(d1.id, mergedChanges, clock)
}
```
